title: Phase 55O publishes two briefings and repairs three dependency maps
summary: FTFN reviewed all five briefings and three dependency maps against their linked evidence. Stack Watch 003 and Stack Watch 004 moved to Published; three older briefings remain In Review with explicit hold reasons. The three maps were rebuilt around Published signals, open evidence gaps, and visible stage boundaries before publication.
evidence_note: Publication applies to the synthesis products, not to any linked In Review signal. Every published product distinguishes official actions and artifacts from later delivery, acceptance, operation, adoption, migration, and scale. Held briefings retain explicit evidence-stage and dated recheck gates.
